integrity: Proof gives explicit all-size tree-pivot paths and a sharp isolated-side obstruction; separate direct-forcing and auxiliary-tree programs reproduce the n=2,3,4 checks. No independent scholarly audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the token-slide/jump graphs of minimum ordinary zero-forcing sets on square rook graphs; no exact diameter claim for the two slide components. Zero-forcing cardinality, the spanning-tree description and minimum-set multiplicity are prior work. Some historical equivalent reconfiguration results may be unindexed.
title: Two orientation islands for minimum zero-forcing slides on square rook graphs
